# Sketchy

> Sketchy is a free multiplayer drawing game with an imposter. Players take turns adding to one shared drawing of a secret word, except one player who doesn't know the word. Then everyone votes on who the imposter is. Play with up to 8 friends on phone or computer, no download or account needed.

Sketchy runs in the browser. Rooms are private and created per game, so there is no public content beyond the pages below.

## Pages

- [Play Sketchy](https://sketchy.sakriitech.com/): Home page with game description, and where to create or join a room
- [Sitemap](https://sketchy.sakriitech.com/sitemap.xml): List of indexable pages

## Optional

- [robots.txt](https://sketchy.sakriitech.com/robots.txt): Crawling rules; room pages (/room/) and the API (/api/) are not for crawlers
- [AI catalog](https://sketchy.sakriitech.com/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): Machine-readable catalog of resources for AI agents
